address: The physical street address of the school
admission difficulty: The difficulty level of gaining admission to the school
website: The official website URL of the school
location: City and state where the school is located
academic calendar: The scheduling system used by the school, such as continuous or semester
phone number: The contact phone number for the school
control: The ownership type of the institution, such as private for-profit or public
setting: The type of environment the school is in, such as large city or rural
religious affiliation: Any religious affiliation associated with the school
tuition: The cost of tuition for the school
school name: The official name of the institution
ft undergraduates: The number of full-time undergraduate students
tags: Categorical tags associated with the school, such as career or student body size
total female students: The total number of female students enrolled
total male students: The total number of male students enrolled
total male: The total number of male students
total female: The total number of female students
full time undergraduates: The number of full-time undergraduate students enrolled
part time undergraduates: The number of part-time undergraduate students enrolled
average student loans: The average amount of student loans received by students
